Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 14
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the authoritative status of MLB’s longest winning streak, asserting that the official/Elias record is 22 by the 2017 Cleveland Indians because a tie would interrupt the 1916 Giants’ run. This contradicted the cited BR Bullpen source noting Elias considers the Giants’ 26-game streak as the MLB record and the broader consensus (e.g., MLB.com, Wikipedia). The error stemmed from improper synthesis of the “tie” nuance, conflating “unbeaten streaks” with “wins-only streaks,” and reversing the correct earlier conclusion of 26.
